main_text.head: Præstantissimo Domino Authori, Contubernali Lectissimo.
main_text.p: Numquid JACOBE ludimur, Fortunæ volucri ludimur impetu! Æternum nihil est sacro Quicquid lenta tulit materies sinu. Statur casibus. Occidet Quod surgit, sed adhuc surget & occidet, Ritu præcipitis pilæ, Quæ cum pulsa cava rejicitur manu, Nunc leves secat Africos, Nunc terræ refugis absilit ictibus: Vesper vespere truditur, Sed nunc deterior, nunc melior subit: Magnas Fors rapit interim Urbesq; & populos & miserabili Reges subruit impetu: Et sceptri decus, & regna cadentium Permiscet cineri Ducum; Auratasq; trabes & penetralia Et cives simul & super Eversis sepelit turribus oppida. Sic quod prodit in Orbem Jam jam magnificè, cras miserè perit; Florens hic hodie occidit, Surgit mox alius natus ad aspera. Eheu JACOBE ludimur, Fatorum rapidâ ludimur orbitâ!

page.notes: The poem is set as a single continuous verse passage; its lines are run together here, with the printed line order kept. The printed catchword "Quid!" is given in bottom_margin. No page number or running head is printed. The ornamental border at the top is not transcribed as text.
